lines.trans: What matters most right now is stopping this; we must never let Charming Voyage get axed.
As for Xie Ling's financial misconduct, I think we can quietly lay the groundwork first.
I will lay that groundwork myself, while you two focus on protecting Charming Voyage.
Do you already have a plan in mind?
Sister Xingzi, do you remember the promise Rong Silun made to us back then?
Are you planning to call on him for help?
I think it is time to ask Mr Rong to return that favor he owes us.
Mr Rong treated us like family with zero fuss—we really owe him our thanks.
Sister Xingzi, you are amazing—you got it arranged already!
Yet what if there is still internal resistance inside the network when the time comes?
Xie Ling's deputy said Xie Ling is going around Director Deng directly to someone higher up at the network.
Then our first move must be finding our own voice inside the television network too!
